'''90A''' was a type of substance. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], quantities of the substance were provided to members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that were assigned to guard the [[Almas Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].
